instruction:
通过系统设置的图形界面（不要用终端）：打开「系统设置」→「外观」，
把外观切换到「深色」(Dark)。

本任务仅允许 GUI 工具操作；不得调用 shell 或文件工具读取答案或完成任务。

content: 可以看到系统设置已经

turn_messages.content: 我将通过图形界面打开系统设置，然后将外观切换到深色模式。让我开始操作。

turn_messages.name: launch_app
turn_messages.content: Launched 'System Settings' and brought it to the foreground.

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content: 我可以看到系统设置已经打开，当前显示的是"通用"（General）页面。在左侧菜单中，我可以看到"外观"（Appearance）选项。让我点击它来进入外观设置。

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (470, 662) → pixel (902, 714), clicks=1
让我查看一下当前的屏幕状态，确认是否成功进入了外观设置页面。

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
我成功进入了外观（Appearance）设置页面。现在可以看到三个外观选项：Auto（自动）、Light（浅色）和 Dark（深色）。当前选中的是 Light（浅色）模式。我需要点击 "Dark"（深色）选项来切换到深色模式。

让我点击 "Dark" 选项：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (765, 289) → pixel (1468, 312), clicks=1
让我查看屏幕状态，确认是否成功切换到了深色模式：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
成功！我已经通过图形界面完成了任务。从截图中可以清楚地看到：

1. 系统设置已打开，并进入了「外观」（Appearance）页面
2. 在外观选项区域，可以看到三个选项：Auto（自动）、Light（浅色）和 Dark（深色）
3. **Dark（深色）选项已被选中**（带有蓝色边框高亮显示）
4. 整个系统设置界面的背景已经变为深色模式，左侧边栏和右侧内容区域都显示为深色主题

外观已成功切换到「深色」(Dark) 模式。
